name: Speak
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Speak, build scripted language roleplay using a user-supplied model and clear lesson objectives. The hard boundary is proprietary speech tutor models, curriculum, mobile experience, and learning data, plus content, pedagogy, and network.
